description: Live browser preview and control now work remotely: the viewer is routed at <tailnet>/live/ through the funnel (auto-ensured), and the console rewrites loopback viewer links to that route so iframes no longer point at the viewer's own localhost.
features: New funnel /live/ route to the noVNC viewer (idempotent, verified reachable over the public internet).
New pure live-url.js: funnel pages rewrite 127.0.0.1:6080 links to the /live/ route (token/scale/view_only preserved); local pages untouched.
Route re-ensured after every browser boot and every funnel enable (best-effort).
Version synced to 0.14.0 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml and updates.json.
